summary: 21 units reviewed; 7 ok, 14 fix. 2 error issues (both in 12.3.1: the genitive of the chiefs is partitive with mitra-sthānīyeṣu, so the agents tell the friendly chiefs themselves, not 'friends of the chiefs'); 27 minor issues, mostly bracketed glosses inside the Hindi (units 2, 5, 11, 12, 13, 16, 17, 18) and small supplied words ('even', 'leading', 'राज्य', 'राजाओं', 'treatment of'). Splits, sandhi and grammar labels are otherwise sound; tokens all present. No regrouping suggested. For a person: (a) 12.3.1 construction (I am confident of the partitive reading, but it reverses the draft); (b) 12.3.14 prakṛti-puruṣa, 'men' vs 'leading men' of the constituents; (c) 12.3.13 asya, officer's or king's. Glossary extended with the chapter's agent/office terms.
